text: Vi mode lets you move around the viewport and scrollback using only the keyboard
quote: The vi mode allows moving around Alacritty's viewport and scrollback using the keyboard.

text: Vi mode supports keyboard selection and copying, including semantic, line, and block selection modes
quote: By default you can start a selection using v and copy it using y. All selection modes that are available with the mouse can be accessed from vi mode, including the semantic (Alt v), line (Shift v) and block selection (Ctrl v).

text: Search the scrollback buffer forward and backward with dedicated keybindings
quote: Search allows you to find anything in Alacritty's scrollback buffer. You can search forward using Ctrl Shift f (Command f on macOS) and backward using Ctrl Shift b (Command b on macOS).

text: In vi mode, search forward with / and backward with ?
quote: In vi mode the search is bound to / for forward and ? for backward search.

text: Bindable keybinding actions jump to the start or end of a search match
quote: The `SearchStart` and `SearchEnd` keybinding actions can be bound if you're looking for a way to jump to the start or the end of a match.

text: Regex hints mark visible text for mouse or keyboard interaction without entering vi mode
quote: Terminal hints allow easily interacting with visible text without having to start vi mode.

text: Run multiple terminal windows from a single Alacritty process to reduce resource usage
quote: Multi-Window — Improve resource usage by using only a single Alacritty process

text: Create new windows with a keybinding action or the alacritty msg create-window subcommand
quote: New windows can be created either by using the `CreateNewWindow` keybinding action, or by executing the `alacritty msg create-window` subcommand.

text: Offers IPC for controlling a running instance through the alacritty msg command
quote: Offer IPC using _alacritty msg_

text: Mouse selection can be expanded with the right button: double-click is semantic, triple-click selects lines, and Ctrl switches to block mode
quote: After making a selection, you can use the right mouse button to expand it. Double-clicking will expand the selection semantically, while triple-clicking will perform line selection. If you hold Ctrl while expanding the selection, it will sw

text: Open URLs by clicking them, with configurable modifier keys and opener program
quote: You can open URLs with your mouse by clicking on them. The modifiers required to be held and program which should open the URL can be setup in the configuration file.

text: Configuration can import additional config files, loaded in order and skipping missing files
quote:
Import additional configuration files.

Imports are loaded in order, skipping all missing files, with the importing file being loaded last.

text: Config files are in plain-text TOML format
quote: Alacritty's configuration file uses the TOML format.

text: Live config reload is enabled by default, though some changes require a restart
quote: live_config_reload = true | false ... Default: true

text: Runs on BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows
quote: The supported platforms currently consist of BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows.

text: Installable through various package managers on Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows
quote: Alacritty can be installed by using various package managers on Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows.

text: Can be installed directly with cargo install
quote: cargo install alacritty

text: Can be built from source with cargo build --release
quote: cargo build --release

text: Build-time feature flags allow selecting backends, such as a Wayland-only build
quote: cargo build --release --no-default-features --features=wayland

text: Prebuilt binaries for macOS and Windows are available on the GitHub releases page
quote:
Prebuilt binaries for macOS and Windows can also be downloaded from the
[GitHub releases page]

text: Measured with vtebench, Alacritty consistently scores better on throughput than competing terminals
quote: Alacritty uses vtebench to quantify terminal emulator throughput and manages to consistently score better than the competition using it.

text: Terminal colors are configurable using #RRGGBB hex values
quote: Colors are specified using their hexadecimal values with a # prefix: #RRGGBB.

text: Can ask the compositor to blur content behind transparent windows
quote: Request compositor to blur content behind transparent windows.

text: Configurable DPI-scaled window padding in pixels
quote: Blank space added around the window in pixels. This padding is scaled by DPI and the specified value is always added at both opposing sides.

text: Adjustable glyph offset controls line spacing and letter spacing
quote: Offset is the extra space around each character. y can be thought of as modifying the line spacing, and x as modifying the letter spacing.

text: Configurable font family, style, and size
quote: normal = { family = "<string>", style = "<string>" } ... size = <float> Font size in points.

text: Built-in custom font for box-drawing characters and legacy computing symbols
quote: Alacritty will use a custom built-in font for box drawing characters (Unicode points U+2500 - U+259F), legacy computing symbols

text: Environment variables in an [env] config section are passed to every spawned process, including the shell
quote: All key-value pairs in the [env] section will be added as environment variables for any process spawned by Alacritty, including its shell.

text: Configurable starting working directory for the shell
quote: Directory the shell is started in. When this is unset, or "None", the working directory of the parent process will be used.

text: Adjustable background opacity from fully transparent to opaque
quote: Background opacity as a floating point number from 0.0 to 1.0. The value 0.0 is completely transparent and 1.0 is opaque.

text: Window decoration options: full, none, transparent, or buttonless
quote: decorations = "Full" | "None" | "Transparent" | "Buttonless"

text: Startup mode can be windowed, maximized, fullscreen, or simple fullscreen
quote: startup_mode = "Windowed" | "Maximized" | "Fullscreen" | "SimpleFullscreen"

text: Window level can be set to always-on-top
quote: AlwaysOnTop — Window is a toplevel window.

text: Configurable scrollback buffer size up to 100,000 lines, or disabled with 0
quote: Maximum number of lines in the scrollback buffer. Specifying 0 will disable scrolling. Limited to 100000.

text: Option key on macOS can be made to behave as Alt
quote: Make Option key behave as Alt.

text: Initial terminal size can be set in lines and columns
quote: Number of lines/columns (not pixels) in the terminal.

text: Terminal applications can be allowed to change the window title
quote: Allow terminal applications to change Alacritty's window title.
